'''Gethul''' was a creature of an unknown origin that was hibernating under the surface of [[Makeb]] for millennia preceding the [[Galactic War]]. No record of the creature existed before its discovery in [[3629 BBY]], although Doctor [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] was later able to find traces of organic matter unique to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] inside its digestive tract, speculating that the creature originated there. Oggurobb also theorized that Gethul was a genetic experiment by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], as it contained their genetic markers, along with those of [[Rathtar/Legends|rathtar]], [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] and dozens of other species. Gethul also possessed an immense mind control power suggesting [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], as demonstrated when a team led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adelade]] uncovered it based on intel from an anonymous source.<ref name="Codex" /> Though not yet fully awake, Adelade and her followers heard Gethul's "song" and fell under its sway, forming a [[Cult of Gethul]] and attempting to fully awaken the creature. Learning of this and fearing that in its full power Gethul could destabilize Makeb's core and obliterate the planet, [[Eternal Alliance]] military Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]] sent a strike team to stop Adelade's plan. The team was [[Cult of Gethul uprising|engaged]] by the cultists of Gethul, as well as Chief Engineer [[Penzaren]] and local wildlife, which Adelade and Gethul were also able to control. Eventually they reached Adelade herself and after defeating her in combat, detonated the [[D-5X]] probe droid loaded with explosives inside Gethul's maw, killing the abomination and stopping its threat.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gethul appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Destroyer Of Worlds" Uprising.
